LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlist_Letter_Title: You have joined the Children of Atom.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlist_Letter_Label: Child, you have taken your first step toward Division. The faithful welcome you, and Atom's glow will provide - wages, provisions, and shelter wherever the faithful gather.\n\n Walk in His light.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlist_Button_Desc: Take your vows with the Children of Atom.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Satisfied: You need to have minimum of 10 goodwill, currently you have only {0} goodwill.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlisted_With_Key: Enlisted with: The Children of Atom
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Menu_Missions_Desc: A confessor asks whether the faithful might be willing to serve Atom's will.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Salary_Desc: You are entitled to collect your tithe from this faction every 14 days.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Provisions_Desc:
Provisions will arrive via your caravan inventory every 10 days:

- Survival meals
- Pemmican
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Storage_Desc: Store items from your caravan to your faction stash. Faction stashes transfer across all of the faction's shrines and will save contents even if you are no longer enlisted.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Sermon_Duty_Desc: Preach Atom's word and gather tithes for $7 an hour.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Ministration_Desc: Receive the laying on of hands from the faithful. This service tends to all of your team with herbal medicine. Immunity gain is also increased while your team is under care.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Devotion_Drills_Desc:
Train alongside the faithful with hourly experience gain on the following skills:

- Shooting, Melee, Intellectual

Hourly experience gain stops when this faction is resting at night.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Resign_Menu_Text: You will resign from the Children of Atom effective immediately. (-25 in relations)
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Resign_Button_Label: You have successfully resigned from the Children of Atom. (-25 relations)
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: cannot join because you are enlisted with their enemy, {HOSTILEFACTION_name}
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The confessors have declared your vows broken. You have been let go from the {FACTION_name}.
LanguageData.FCP_CoA_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your faction. Amount of the faithful they send depends on your current relations.
